name: Lvgl → Widget Refresh
description: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#actions-action) re-evaluates all properties specified with lambdas in the specified widget's configuration. This offers an alternative technique to using the `lvgl.widget.update` action, which updates specified properties.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: The ID of a widget configured in LVGL to refresh (may also be a list of widgets).
